lines.text: Did you know? Man is Latin for hand.
Manner: a way of handling things.
Quick quiz! Which means a way of handling things?
Manner! It means a way of handling things.

words.ex: The demand for manual labour has declined.
She manages a team of ten people.
She spoke in a calm and friendly manner.
